WITH target_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008
      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
    SELECT r.time AS champion_time_str
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN target_race AS tr ON r.raceId = tr.raceId
    WHERE r.position = 1
      AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
last_finisher AS (
    SELECT r.time AS last_gap_str
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN target_race AS tr ON r.raceId = tr.raceId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r.positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN LENGTH(c.champion_time_str) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.champion_time_str, ':', '')) = 2 THEN
                (
                    CAST(substr(c.champion_time_str, 1, instr(c.champion_time_str, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
                    + CAST(
                        substr(
                            c.champion_time_str,
                            instr(c.champion_time_str, ':') + 1,
                            instr(substr(c.champion_time_str, instr(c.champion_time_str, ':') + 1), ':') - 1
                        ) AS REAL
                    ) * 60
                    + CAST(
                        substr(
                            c.champion_time_str,
                            instr(c.champion_time_str, ':') + instr(substr(c.champion_time_str, instr(c.champion_time_str, ':') + 1), ':') + 1
                        ) AS REAL
                    )
                )
            WHEN LENGTH(c.champion_time_str) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.champion_time_str, ':', '')) = 1 THEN
                (
                    CAST(substr(c.champion_time_str, 1, instr(c.champion_time_str, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
                    + CAST(substr(c.champion_time_str, instr(c.champion_time_str, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
                )
        END AS champion_seconds,
        CASE
            WHEN LENGTH(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2)) - LENGTH(REPLACE(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2), ':', '')) = 1 THEN
                (
                    CAST(substr(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2), 1, instr(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
                    + CAST(substr(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2), instr(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2), ':') + 1) AS REAL)
                )
            WHEN LENGTH(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2)) - LENGTH(REPLACE(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2), ':', '')) = 0 THEN
                CAST(substr(l.last_gap_str, 2) AS REAL)
        END AS gap_seconds
    FROM champion AS c
    CROSS JOIN last_finisher AS l
)
SELECT ((gap_seconds) * 100.0 / (champion_seconds + gap_seconds)) AS percentage_faster
FROM parsed

   SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) || '-01') = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) || '-01') = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
